arxiv-2104-13808.title: On the influence of equilibrium tides on transit-timing variations of close-in super-Earths
arxiv-2104-13808.creator: G. O. Gomes, E. Bolmont, S. Blanco-Cuaresma
arxiv-2104-13808.description: Abstract With the current growth in the discovery of close-in low-mass exoplanets, recent works have been published with the aim to discuss the influences of planetary interior structure parameters on both the shape of transit light curves as well as variations on the timing of transit events of these planets.

arxiv-2109-13351.title: SOAR/Goodman Spectroscopic Assessment of Candidate Counterparts of the LIGO–Virgo Event GW190814
arxiv-2109-13351.creator: D. L. Tucker, M. P. Wiesner, S. S. Allam, M. Soares-Santos, C. R. Bom, M. Butner, A. Garcia, R. Morgan, F. Olivares E, A. Palmese, L. Santana-Silva, A. Shrivastava, J. Annis, J. García-Bellido, M. S. S. Gill, K. Herner, C. D. Kilpatrick, M. Makler, N. Sherman, A. Amara, H. Lin, M. Smith, E. Swann, I
arxiv-2109-13351.description: Abstract On 2019 August 14 at 21:10:39 UTC, the LIGO/Virgo Collaboration (LVC) detected a possible neutron star-black hole merger (NSBH), the first ever identified. An extensive search for an optical counterpart of this event, designated GW190814, was undertaken using the Dark Energy Camera (DECam) on the 4m Victor M. Blanco Telescope at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory.

arxiv-2311-15954.title: A Quantitative Approach to Understand Self-Supervised Models as Cross-lingual Feature Extractors
arxiv-2311-15954.creator: Shuyue Stella Li, Beining Xu, Xiangyu Zhang, Hexin Liu, Wenhan Chao, Leibny Paola Garcia
arxiv-2311-15954.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shuyue Stella Li, Beining Xu, Xiangyu Zhang, Hexin Liu, Wenhan Chao, Leibny Paola Garcia. In this work, we study the features extracted by English self-supervised learning (SSL) models in cross-lingual contexts and propose a new metric to predict the quality of feature representations. Using asr ( asr ) as a downstream task, we analyze the effect of model size, training objectives, and model architecture on the models’ performance as a feature extractor for a set of topologically diverse corpora.

arxiv-2401-15705.title: Spatial profile of plasma temperature generated by discharge in 3D printed capillary
arxiv-2401-15705.creator: Niv Barkai, Noa kliss, Yair Ferber, Yoav Raz, Rotem Liran, Mordechai Botton, Arie Zigler
arxiv-2401-15705.description: Abstract A method for evaluating the radial temperature profile of a plasma channel is presented. The radiation spectrum of mixture of Hydrogen Nitrogen plasma in capillary discharge is collected. Assuming a local thermal equilibrium, the temperature is derived from the ratio of two emission lines ( N + N^{+} , N 2 + N^{2+} ).

arxiv-2408-01697.title: Invariant Graph Learning Meets Information Bottleneck for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
arxiv-2408-01697.creator: Wenyu Mao, Jiancan Wu ( \Letter ), Haoyang Liu, Yongduo Sui, Xiang Wang
arxiv-2408-01697.description: Abstract Graph out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains a major challenge in graph learning since graph neural networks (GNNs) often suffer from severe performance degradation under distribution shifts. Invariant learning, aiming to extract invariant features across varied distributions, has recently emerged as a promising approach for OOD generalization.

arxiv-2409-12159.title: WeHelp: A Shared Autonomy System for Wheelchair Users
arxiv-2409-12159.creator: Abulikemu Abuduweili, Alice Wu, Tianhao Wei, Weiye Zhao
arxiv-2409-12159.description: Abstract There is a large population of wheelchair users. Most of the wheelchair users need help with daily tasks. However, according to recent reports, their needs are not properly satisfied due to the lack of caregivers. Therefore, in this project, we develop WeHelp, a shared autonomy system aimed for wheelchair users.

arxiv-2411-17609.title: Parametric Resonance in RF Axion Haloscopes
arxiv-2411-17609.creator: Kiara C. Ruffin, Gray Rybka
arxiv-2411-17609.description: Abstract The axion were proposed as a result to a solution to the Strong CP Problem in quantum chromodynamics (QCD) and is now considered a leading candidate for dark matter. Direct axion dark matter detection experiments are challenging due to the axion’s weak interaction with electromagnetism.

arxiv-2507-05909.title: Universal Coacting Hopf Algebra of a finite-dimensional Algebra over an Operad
arxiv-2507-05909.creator: Saikat Goswami, Satyendra Kumar Mishra, Suman Pattanayak
arxiv-2507-05909.description: Abstract . A. L. Agore and G. Militaru constructed a new invariant (a “universal coacting Hopf algebra”) for some finite-dimensional binary quadratic algebras such as Lie/Leibniz algebras, associative algebras, and Poisson algebras with prominent applications. In our recent work, we extended their construction from the binary case to Lie-Yamaguti algebras (an algebra with a binary and a ternary bracket).

pmc-10664975.title: Chromosomal characterization of three species of Serrasalmini (Serrasalmidae: Characiformes)
pmc-10664975.creator: Alan Gomes dos Santos, José Francisco de Sousa e Souza, Simone Cardoso Soares, Celeste Mutuko Nakayama, Eliana Feldberg
pmc-10664975.description: The tribe Serrasalmini is a diverse group with paraphyletic genera and taxonomic uncertainties. Several studies have been carried out in this group of fish in order to understand this problem, including the cytogenetic approach. In this study, three species of a clade of Serrasalmini were characterized cytogenetically - Pristobrycon striolatus, Catoprion absconditus and Pygopristis denticulatus.

pmc-10710874.title: Incidence, Patterns, and Characteristics of Patients With Acute Kidney Injury Requiring Renal Replacement Therapy in Cancer Settings
pmc-10710874.creator: Summra Siddiq, Zakia Hussain, Janmohamed Mubarakali, Anam Nazir
pmc-10710874.description: BackgroundCancer patients are at increased risk of multi-organ failure due to either the primary disease burden or certain non-cancer-related risk factors. Among the most common complications is acute kidney injury (AKI), which is frequently seen in cancer settings. Among patients with cancer, the incidence of renal injury reaches up to 12.5%.

pmc-11536037.title: Auxin response factor 10 insensitive to miR160regulation induces apospory-like phenotypes in Arabidopsis
pmc-11536037.creator: Silvina Pessino, Mara Cucinotta, Carolina Colono, Elena Costantini, Davide Perrone, Maurizio Di Marzo, Giada Callizaya Terceros, Rosanna Petrella, Chiara Mizzotti, Celeste Azzaro, Maricel Podio, Gianpiero Marconi, Emidio Albertini, Hugh Dickinson, Lucia Colombo, Marta A. Mendes
pmc-11536037.description: SummaryThe Arabidopsis megaspore mother cell (MMC) arises from somatic cells in the ovule primordium and enters meiosis to generate four megaspores. Only the most chalazal (functional megaspore, FM) survives, undergoing a series of mitoses to form the female gametophyte. We show that this commitment to the sexual germline requires spatial regulation of AUXINRESPONSEFACTOR10 (ARF10).

pmc-11692647.title: FACTORS ASSOCIATED WITH LONGITUDINAL DIGITAL SURVEY ENGAGEMENT IN THE ELECTRONIC FRAMINGHAM HEART STUDY
pmc-11692647.creator: Yuankai Zhang, Chathurangi Pathiravasan, Jian Rong, Belinda Borrelli, Jamie Faro, Xuzhi Wang, Chunyu Liu, Joanne Murabito
pmc-11692647.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Smartphone surveys are increasingly used in health research, but factors affecting long-term survey response among older adults, are not well understood. We conducted a study of 611 participants (mean age 74 years, 57% women, 86% White) from the electronic Framingham Heart Study to identify sociodemographic, health-related, and technological factors associated with survey response over 32 weeks assessed longitudinally across four 8-week periods.

pmc-12489923.title: The cation channel Trpa1 and chemokine Cxcl1 mediate axonal degeneration in spared nerve injury–induced neuropathic pain
pmc-12489923.creator: Liu-Qing Ye, Xuan-Xuan Huang, Hua-Feng Liu, Tian Li, Yu Wang, Xiao-Hui Chen, Yu Zheng, Zuo-Ming Chen, Qin-Yu Liu, Fan Yang, Nan-Qi Li, Li Wan
pmc-12489923.description: Demyelination of peripheral nerve injury is a vital cause of neuropathic pain. Schwann cells play an important role in supporting and maintaining the removal and regeneration of myelin debris from neuronal axons in the peripheral nervous system. Creating a good immune microenvironment would promote the Schwann cells to repair the injured nerve and reverse the allodynia of neuropathic pain.

pmc-12620450.title: Adolescent mice exhibit lower reward sensitivity than adults
pmc-12620450.creator: Klaudia Misiołek, Magdalena Chrószcz, Marta Klimczak, Aleksandra Rzeszut, Julia Netczuk, Barbara Ziółkowska, Łukasz Szumiec, Maria Kaczmarczyk-Jarosz, Zofia Harda, Jan Rodriguez Parkitna
pmc-12620450.description: IntroductionAdolescence shapes adaptive adult behaviors. It is characterized by increased responsiveness to socially salient stimuli and heightened sensitivity to rewards in peer settings. The particular importance of social context during adolescence indicates that neural circuits responsible for social reward may develop along a different trajectory from those involved in non-social reward processing.

pmc-12773541.title: Abstract 230: Endovascular therapy for large core ischemic strokes: Meta‐analysis of randomized clinical trials
pmc-12773541.creator: Mohammad Hossein Abbasi, Ashkan Shoamanesh, David S Liebeskind, Steven Warach, Hamidreza Saber
pmc-12773541.description: IntroductionBackground: Patients with acute strokes with large infarct size are traditionally excluded from endovascular therapies, as like as clinical care. However, questions remain with respect to the safety and efficacy of EVT in these patients.MethodsWe conducted a meta‐analysis based on pooled data from SELECT 2 trial [1], ANGEL‐ASPECT trial [2], RESCUE Japan [3], and HERMES study [4].

pmc-13095512.title: Significant association of RANKL polymorphisms with bone metastasis among patients with breast cancer
pmc-13095512.creator: Haoyu Lian, Siyuan Zhou, Huanyang He, Qian Liu, Jinmin Zhao
pmc-13095512.description: ObjectiveThe purpose of this study was to reveal the genetic correlation of RANKL polymorphisms with bone metastasis in breast cancer patients.MethodsIn this study, 139 bone metastasis patients and 152 no metastasis were included as the case and control groups. Real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and allelic discrimination method were respectively applied for the genotyping of rs7325635 and rs2277438.

pmc-13134510.title: Genomic Profiling in Localized Prostate Cancer: Associations With Biochemical Recurrence and Response to Salvage Radiotherapy
pmc-13134510.creator: Kenji Zennami, Tetsuya Takimoto, Takuhisa Nukaya, Makoto Sumitomo, Mayu Takeda, Eiji Sugihara, Hideyuki Saya, Ryoichi Shiroki
pmc-13134510.description: The clinical significance of comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) has been established in metastatic castration‐resistant prostate cancer (PC). However, the role of genomic profiling in localized PC remains unclear. In this exploratory study, we evaluated somatic genomic alterations in localized PC using an in‐house CGP platform to examine their associations with biochemical recurrence (BCR) and recurrence‐free survival (RFS) after radical prostatectomy.

pmc-13521941.title: Whole transcriptome sequencing and ceRNA regulatory network in diabetic peripheral neuropathy
pmc-13521941.creator: Qi Yan, Ming Zhang, Li-Juan Xu, Jing Ma, Jing Wang, Xian-Min Wang, Li Ma
pmc-13521941.description: Although diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is a serious complication of diabetes, its molecular causes are still unclear. The aim of this study was therefore to further investigate the pathogenesis of diabetes through whole transcriptome sequencing. Methods:We performed whole transcriptome sequencing on sciatic nerve samples from Sprague–Dawley (SD) rats.
